claims.description: The deterministic helper suite covers response rejection/abort, bounded non-settlement, settled payload capture, released-body hard failure, request-attempt classification, and expanded parallel-load timing.
The returning-learner harness starts exact-response body consumption from the matching response event before Back and leaves production code/config unchanged.
The mutation-sensitive red-green-revert run demonstrates the former response-settlement-only mechanism rejects after body release while the event-time seam passes.
The Playwright configuration preserves four workers for custom-domain staging and the focused control explicitly uses one worker with zero retries.
Local deterministic validation and the exact staging proof status are recorded for PR review; hosted exact-head checks remain a landing/CI gate.
